title: Remote Config
description: Firebase Remote Config with typed defaults, fetch-and-activate on launch, and a React provider for feature flags and kill switches.

markers.block:
['@react-native-firebase/app', { ios: { disableSPM: true } }],
    ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { useFrameworks: 'static', forceStaticLinking: ['RNFBApp', 'RNFBAnalytics', 'RNFBRemoteConfig', 'RNFBCrashlytics', 'RNFBPerf', 'RNFBAppCheck', 'RNFBFirestore', 'RNFBAuth', 'RNFBMessaging'] } }],

notes: Web uses the Firebase JS remoteConfig SDK; native uses @react-native-firebase/remote-config (development build).
Edit DEFAULTS in lib/remote-config.ts to match your Remote Config console keys.
iOS uses CocoaPods Firebase (disableSPM) with static frameworks — required on Xcode 26+; SPM + dynamic hits SwiftUICore linker errors.
